title: 12 Best Fine Dining in Adelaide
description: Discover Adelaide's top fine dining restaurants for 2026. From innovative Modern Australian at Restaurant Botanic to iconic vineyard views at Magill Estate, find your perfect gourmet experience. Explore exquisite cuisine, unique atmospheres, and insider tips for an unforgettable meal in Adelaide.

places.name: Restaurant Botanic
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Seasonal Tasting Menu with paired South Australian wines.

places.name: Magill Estate Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Chef's Tasting Menu, ideally paired with Penfolds' iconic wines like Grange.

places.name: Africola
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Go for the 'Let Us Feed You' tasting menu to experience a full range of their exciting dishes.

places.name: Arkhe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their daily changing menu, but keep an eye out for their aged duck or premium steak cuts from the wood oven.

places.name: Fugazzi Bar & Dining Room
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their freshly made pastas, particularly the Cacio e Pepe, and don't skip the tiramisu.

places.name: Fishbank
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Start with a selection from the Raw Bar (oysters, sashimi) and then choose from their daily market fish, simply grilled.

places.name: Chianti Classico
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their famous handmade pasta dishes, especially the Pappardelle al Ragu di Cinghiale (wild boar ragu).

places.name: Georges on Waymouth
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their roasted duck breast is a perennial favourite, or any of their seafood preparations.

places.name: Shobosho
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Shobosho Feed Me' menu is the best way to sample their diverse offerings, especially their yakitori skewers and dumplings.

places.name: Sôl Rooftop Bar & Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their share plates are designed to be enjoyed with the view; don't miss their signature cocktails.

places.name: Press Food & Wine
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their dry-aged steaks or the famous burger (for a more casual, high-end option) are excellent choices.

places.name: Ginza Miyako Japanese Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Deluxe Sashimi and Sushi Platter, or a Teppanyaki set menu for an interactive experience.
